up: List all compounds that are reported in the document identified by the ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2095176. Return the following columns for each compound: compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES. Ensure that all compounds associated with that document are included, regardless of whether they have activity data. To do this, start from the docs table filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2095176', then join compound_records on doc_id to get the compounds mentioned in that document, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno to get compound identifiers and names, and optionally join compound_structures on molregno to get SMILES. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS preferred_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2095176';
